Avengers: Endgame.text: Out-earned Infinity War's entire theatrical run in eleven days.
Avengers: Endgame.evidence: It grossed $2.8 billion worldwide during its initial theatrical run, surpassing Infinity War's entire theatrical run in eleven days, setting several box-office records, and surpassing Avatar (2009) to become the highest-grossing film of all time.

Avatar.text: The blue Na'vi go back to a dream Cameron's mother had about a 12-foot-tall blue-skinned woman.
Avatar.evidence: Long before Cameron started work on Avatar, his mother told him about a dream she had which featured a blue-skinned woman 12 feet (4 m) tall. Cameron liked the image and created a race of tall, beautiful blue people with golden eyes for his first screenplay

Spider-Man: Brand New Day.text: Tom Holland pitched puberty-like changes to Peter's powers; a separate idea to give him a pet dog was rejected.
Spider-Man: Brand New Day.evidence: Holland pitched that Parker's powers should go through puberty-like changes, which the creative team liked and developed further. Another proposal was to give him a pet dog, which was rejected.

Avatar: The Way of Water.text: Kate Winslet held her breath underwater for over seven minutes, beating Tom Cruise's record for a film scene.
Avatar: The Way of Water.evidence: While filming one underwater scene, Winslet held her breath for over seven minutes, breaking the record for longest breath hold while shooting a film scene underwater, a record previously held by Tom Cruise while shooting Mission: Impossible – Rogue Nation (2015).

Titanic.text: A Halifax cemetery of Titanic victims has a grave marked "J. Dawson"; the producers only learned of it after release.
Titanic.evidence: Although Jack was a fictional character, in Fairview Cemetery in Halifax, Nova Scotia, where 121 Titanic victims are buried, there is a grave labeled "J. Dawson". The producers did not know of the real J. Dawson until after the film was released.

Ne Zha 2.text: It needed only 11 days to beat The Force Awakens' record for the biggest box office in a single territory.
Ne Zha 2.evidence: It also surpassed the single territory box office record of US$936.7 million set by Star Wars: The Force Awakens (2015), 11 days into its release.

Star Wars: The Force Awakens.text: Daniel Craig makes a cameo in it as a stormtrooper.
Star Wars: The Force Awakens.evidence: Daniel Craig, Michael Giacchino, and Nigel Godrich cameo as stormtroopers.

Avengers: Infinity War.text: Dave Bautista had to sit in a sauna at the end of every filming day to get his Drax makeup off.
Avengers: Infinity War.evidence: Dave Bautista as Drax the Destroyer: A member of the Guardians and warrior in search of vengeance against Thanos for killing his family. At the end of each day of filming, Bautista would have to sit in a sauna to remove his makeup.

Spider-Man: No Way Home.text: When Sony and Marvel fell out over Spider-Man, Tom Holland personally lobbied both studio bosses to make up.
Spider-Man: No Way Home.evidence: Unable to come to an agreement, Sony announced that it would be moving forward on the next Spider-Man film without Feige or Marvel's involvement. ... However, after this fan reaction continued at Disney's biennial convention D23, and at the urging of Holland who personally spoke to Disney CEO Bob Iger and Sony Pictures Motion Picture Group chairman Tom Rothman, the companies returned to negotiations.

Zootopia 2.text: Disney CEO Bob Iger voices a tiger weatherman named Bob Tiger.
Zootopia 2.evidence: Bob Iger as Bob Tiger, a tiger weatherman ... On February 8, 2023, during the Q1 earnings call, Disney CEO Bob Iger confirmed that the sequel was in active development.
